title: Business Development Representative
description:
Job Description
If you're energized by connecting with people, spotting opportunities, and sparking meaningful conversations, you'll thrive at Irth Solutions. Here, your outreach isn't just about selling software-it's about equipping the people who keep our world running safely and efficiently.
We deliver resilient, risk-reducing solutions for critical infrastructure in utilities, renewable energy, midstream, telecom, and more. Our vision integrates business intelligence, analytics, and geospatial data to provide 360-degree situational awareness for proactive risk management and workforce efficiency. Our solutions also help land developers reduce risk and improve efficiency in right-of-way acquisition and land use agreement management.
This will be a remote based role with minimal travel. The candidate should be able to work independently and be self-driven. The candidate should have demonstrated success promoting software solutions, bringing in qualified leads to the Account Executives.
The candidate should be competitive, self-driven and possess a natural curiosity. The role will require a comfort level in a variety of settings, ranging from spending time alone researching, to making discovery calls and promoting events. The successful candidate must be able to understand and convey the benefits of the Irth offerings. Experience in SaaS is a must, with specific domain experience in work management or field service software being a bonus.
Expectations and Responsibilities:

• Develop pipeline by researching, cold calling, and executing email campaign strategies

• Learn a multifaceted product suite and drive sells across North America, Europe, and Latin America

• Qualify inbound opportunities and develop a strong pipeline for Account Executives

• Meet monthly and quarterly qualified pipeline goals

• Log all activities in salesforce and hubspot; and validate/correct contact data housed within the CRM

• Coordinate lead processing with support from Marketing for all campaigns and conferences

• Manage pre and post conference + webinar outreach for existing and new customers

• Provide market intel based on information gathered

• Work with Account Executive to develop and execute strategic attack plans for new logos

• Participate in required business events, conferences, trade shows and seminars

• Ability to travel occasionally, typically 10%.

• Most of all: Bring a warm and friendly presence who is a self-starter, who is driven, hungry, and will ask questions - You will often be the first impression of our company!

Requirements
Qualifications & Job Objectives:

• At least 1 year experience in a business development role

• SaaS experience preferred

• Consistently demonstrate excellent organization, time management, and oral and written communication skills, both internally and externally

• Proven success hunting new business leads and scheduling qualified meetings

• Bachelor’s degree preferred, but not required

• This is a quota carrying position, candidate should be able to meet or exceed quota reliably

Benefits

• Join a dynamic, growing company that is well respected in its industry.

• Competitive salary

• Health plans options including medical, dental, & vision

• 401k (US), RSP (Canada) + company match

• Flexible PTO policy plus company-paid holidays 

• Benefits options such as health insurance, life insurance, discounts and perks programs

• Generous “work from home” stipend to get you started

• Team events including monthly lunches for everyone, volunteer outings, and quarterly gatherings

• Hybrid employees have access to snacks, beverages and coffee at our Columbus, Ohio office

description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Mechatronics Engineer to join our nuclear fuel recycling engineering team.

Position Description

The mechatronics engineer is responsible for designing automated systems and robotic material-handling equipment for remote-operated processes in radiological hot cells for the Oklo Fuel Recycling Facility. Day-to-day activities will include system design, CAD modeling, requirements generation, and eventual prototyping and integration of augmentation into various systems. This role involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams including facility design, chemical engineering, pyroprocessing, instrumentation and controls, software engineering, process modeling, quality assurance, and licensing.

There is a strong preference for candidates in the Oak Ridge, TN area.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Designing robotic and electromechanical systems for remote handling of materials in high-temperature, high corrosion, and high-radiation environments

• Defining architecture, specifications, control logic, and performance criteria for automated material-handling and process systems

• Integrating automation hardware, sensors, and control systems for reliable unmanned operations

• Serving as technical lead for automation and handling systems across their lifecycle

• Developing documentation to guide fabrication, installation, commissioning, operation, and maintenance of automated equipment

• Generating technical documentation for regulatory filings and internal knowledge capture

• Building, testing, and iterating on prototypes for automation and handling subsystems

• Writing clear, concise reports and communicating results across disciplines

 

Minimum Qualifications:

• Engineering education in mechatronics, mechanical engineering, robotics, electrical engineering, or related discipline

• 5 to 10 years’ experience with  automation or robotic system design

• Hands-on experience with PLCs, industrial automation, and robotics programming

• Expert proficiency with CAD software, preferably Solidworks

• Broad familiarity with engineering principles and strong systems integration intuition

 

Bonus Qualifications:

• Experience with robotic arms, conveyors, or other automated handling systems

• Experience designing for remote or hazardous environments

• Experience with radiological hot cell environments

• Experience with high-temperature (>500 °C) equipment design

• Knowledge of GD&T and design for manufacturing

• Experience with simulation tools (e.g., ANSYS, ROS, MATLAB/Simulink)

• Background in nuclear, petrochemical, or pharmaceutical industries with automated systems

• Experience deploying or working on pilot plants or unmanned manufacturing systems

• Located by Oak Ridge, TN

 

Competencies

We are looking for a Mechatronics Engineer who is

• Passionate about clean energy and advanced fission

• Proficient in 2D/3D modeling and CAD for mechanical and robotic systems

• Experienced with electromechanical systems, controls, and automation integration

• Energized by prototyping and deploying real-world hardware

• Creative and persistent when tackling novel engineering challenges

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment

• A strong communicator, both in technical writing and in collaborative discussions

title: Langfuse - Senior Backend Engineer (US-East)
description:
WHY BACKEND ENGINEERING AT LANGFUSE

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Langfuse ingests terabytes of AI tracing data per day. When a Fortune 50 company instruments their application with Langfuse, they hit the infrastructure you built. Everything you ship is open source and immediately visible.

The core of your role is making Langfuse fast and affordable at scale: owning the ingestion pipeline, optimizing ClickHouse data models and queries so dashboards load instantly, and building the backend abstractions that let product engineers ship data-heavy features without reinventing the plumbing each time.

You will also make sure Langfuse runs everywhere. You’ll operate Langfuse Cloud across multiple production environments, and make self-hosting effortless. You will support a single Docker Compose setup to enterprise-grade Helm chart deployment.

 

You won’t be solving these problems alone. Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the people who built the database you’re optimizing are one channel away. Few backend roles give you that kind of access to the internals of your core datastore.

 

YOU WILL GROW AT LANGFUSE BY

- Own and optimize our ingestion pipeline: Langfuse ingests massive volumes of tracing data through a pipeline that flows from our API to ClickHouse. You'll work on throughput, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency at every stage of this pipeline.

- Make ClickHouse fast: our tracing data lives in ClickHouse. You'll design schemas, optimize merge strategies, tune batch inserts, write and review analytical queries that power dashboards and the UI. You'll become an expert on ClickHouse internals - and you'll have the ClickHouse database engineering team one channel away.

- Build new infrastructure-heavy features: things like LLM-as-a-Judge (where we post-process large volumes of ingested data asynchronously), alerting at scale, client-code execution, or batch dataset operations. Build the foundation and, if you like, dip your toes into the frontend for those.

- Test with real data in production: when evaluating a new ClickHouse schema, migration, or query optimization, you'll run load tests against production data to validate that changes actually improve things. We don't guess at performance. We prototype new table designs, run them in parallel on real traffic, and compare before committing.

- Scale for what's next: we're growing fast and new product directions like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale.

 

LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR INFRASTRUCTURE

- From Zero to Scale: Langfuse's Infrastructure Evolution https://langfuse.com/blog/2024-12-langfuse-v3-infrastructure-evolution - deep dive into how we went from Postgres to ClickHouse

- Max talking infrastructure at ClickHouse OpenHouse Amsterdam https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NXYQ5odATrM - recording of our CTO walking through the architecture

- Architecture https://langfuse.com/handbook/product-engineering/architecture

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Strong backend engineer who gets excited about database internals, query optimization, and distributed systems

- You get excited when working with a ton of data

- Experience with analytical databases, data pipelines, or high-throughput event processing. ClickHouse experience is a big plus but not required

- You organize yourself. You have strong opinions about what to build and how to ship it

- Comfortable reading and writing TypeScript (our backend) and SQL

- Interest in open source software and genuine enjoyment talking to users about their scaling challenges

- Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

- CS or quantitative degree preferred

 

Bonus points:

 

- Experience with ClickHouse, other OLAP databases, or observability infrastructure

- Former founder

- Background in building data-intensive systems at scale

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
GenLogs is a transportation-technology company building the next generation of truck intelligence. Through a nationwide network of sensors and proprietary data, we deliver real-time, high-fidelity insights into freight movement for commercial supply-chain customers and public-sector agencies. Our mission is to strengthen America’s logistics backbone, combat freight fraud and cargo theft, and provide near-instantaneous visibility into commercial motor vehicle activity across major freight corridors. By operating at the intersection of edge sensing, computer vision, AI-driven analytics, and large-scale field deployment, GenLogs is transforming how transportation data is captured, secured, and commercialized.
ABOUT THE DATA TEAM
The Data Science team at GenLogs transforms raw observational data from the Trident sensor network into high-value intelligence used by law-enforcement agencies, regulators, ports, and private-sector freight operators. We build models, analytics, and measurement frameworks that enable vehicle detection, entity resolution, behavioral insights, fraud and theft indicators, compliance signals, and network-wide operational performance metrics. Our work sits at the center of the freight intelligence platform, shaping how billions of roadside observations become actionable information. We partner closely with Engineering and Product to deploy algorithms at scale and with Go-to-Market teams to define customer-facing analyses that drive real operational outcomes. The team blends statistical rigor, ML capability, and domain expertise to create a new standard for freight intelligence in the United States.
ABOUT THE JOB
You’re a problem solver at heart. You thrive at the intersection of engineering, computer science, and data, you’re motivated by questions that don’t have obvious answers, and you love to architect and build reliable systems that enable whole organizations to build world class analytics. You bring a background in engineering, computer science, physics, applied math, or another hard science discipline, and you enjoy applying that technical foundation to real-world data challenges.
You are energized by ambiguity, obsessed with understanding how complex systems behave, and capable of breaking down big problems into tractable iterations. You ask great questions, validate assumptions with data, and are relentless in your pursuit of signal over noise.
WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Python and SQL.

• Develop ingestion workflows with AWS Firehose , S3, and related services.

• Create and optimize dbt models, tests, and incremental logic.

• Tune Snowflake queries and warehouse usage for cost and performance.

• Operate and improve Airflow DAGs for reliable execution and monitoring.

• Maintain high data quality, data integrity, and pipeline SLA commitments.

• Bring clarity to ambiguous requirements and propose practical solutions.

• Lead data engineering best practices and influence architectural decisions.

• Drive projects independently, from definition to delivery.

• Collaborate with engineering, analytics, and ML teams to support shared goals.

• Build feature pipelines to support ML workflows.

• Support model deployment, monitoring, and automated retraining.

• Add data validation and quality checks across ML and analytics pipelines.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

•
5+ years of experience in data engineering or software engineering.

• Strong Python and SQL skills.

• Hands-on experience with Snowflake , AWS Firehose/S3 , Airflow , and dbt .

• Ability to work independently and execute in a dynamic environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with geospatial data (e.g., spatial joins, geometry processing, or geospatial libraries).

• Experience with ML or MLOps pipelines.

• Knowledge of Snowflake streams, tasks, and performance tuning.

• Experience with large-scale or semi-structured datasets.

title: Web Scraping Specialist
description:
Position Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled Web Scraping Architect to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining web scraping processes to gather data from various online sources efficiently and accurately. As a Web Scraping Specialist, you will play a crucial role in collecting data for competitor analysis, and other business intelligence purposes.
Responsibilities:

• Data Source Identification: Identify relevant websites and online sources from which data needs to be scraped. Collaborate with the team to understand data requirements and objectives.

• Data Extraction: Create and maintain web scraping scripts or programs to extract the required data. Ensure the code is optimized, reliable, and can handle changes in the website's structure.

• Data Cleansing and Validation: Cleanse and validate the collected data to eliminate errors, inconsistencies, and duplicates. Ensure data integrity and accuracy throughout the process.

• Monitoring and Maintenance: Continuously monitor and maintain the web scraping processes. Address any issues that arise due to website changes, data format modifications, or anti-scraping mechanisms.

• Scalability and Performance: Optimize web scraping procedures for efficiency and scalability, especially when dealing with a large volume of data or multiple data sources.

• Compliance and Legal Considerations: Stay up-to-date with legal and ethical considerations related to web scraping, including website terms of service, copyright, and privacy regulations.

• Documentation: Maintain detailed documentation of web scraping processes, data sources, and methodologies. Create clear and concise instructions for others to follow.

• Collaboration: Collaborate with other teams such as data analysts, developers, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver insights effectively.

• Security: Implement security measures to ensure the confidentiality and protection of sensitive data throughout the scraping process.

Requirements:

• Proven experience of 4+ years as a Web Scraping Specialist or similar role, with a track record of successful web scraping projects.

• Expertise in handling dynamic content, user-agent rotation, bypass CAPTCHAs, rate limits, and utilization of proxy services.

• Knowledge on browser fingerprinting

• Has leadership experience.

• Proficiency in programming languages commonly used for web scraping, such as Python, BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, or Selenium.

• Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, XPath, and other web technologies relevant to web scraping and Coding.

• Knowledge and experience in best of class data storage and retrieval of large volume of scraped data.

• Understanding of web scraping best practices, including handling dynamic content, user-agent rotation, and IP address management.

• Attention to detail and the ability to handle and process large volumes of data accurately.

• Familiarity with data cleansing techniques and data validation processes.

• Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Knowledge of web scraping ethics, legal considerations, and compliance with website terms of service.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing web environments

Preferred Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.

• Experience with cloud-based solutions and distributed web scraping systems.

• Familiarity with APIs and data extraction from non-public sources.

• Knowledge of machine learning techniques for data extraction and natural language

Our values include: Growing our People, Building Belonging, Innovating Responsibly, Delivering Excellence and Creating Customer Success.

title: KIP Spring 2027 - Research Intern - Citizens Against Government Waste
description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!
Citizens Against Government Waste (CAGW) offers a wide variety of opportunities to college students across the country. Unpaid research, communications, and government affairs internships are available on a year-round basis and can vary in length from a semester to a few weeks in duration. Interns can choose to work part-time or full-time, as hours of work are extremely flexible. Our daily work with Capitol Hill and the White House, as well as government agencies and other nonprofit organizations, provides a close and invaluable look at how Washington works. Since CAGW maintains a small staff, interns gain hands-on experience in all aspects of CAGW’s activities. Many projects involve working closely with staff members, while others require a great deal of independence. Interns are considered important members of our staff and actively participate in staff meetings and other events. While interns will also be required to perform clerical duties from time to time, much of the work will be substantive.
Research Internship
Assist in formulating policy papers and collect data for original investigative studies. Research and write for CAGW’s annual publications, which include the Congressional Pig Book, Prime Cuts, Government WasteWatch eNews, and special projects, including issue briefs, and policy papers. Interns will have the opportunity to initiate projects. Research internships are also available in specific areas, including healthcare and science, technology and telecommunications, federal regulations and taxation.

Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. Our admissions office treats all program participants and applicants with honesty, dignity, respect and sensitivity. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of color, race, religion, religious creed, sex, gender or gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, ethnicity, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy (including medical needs which may arise from pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), military and veteran status, genetic information, marital or familial status, political affiliation, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances.

title: GM - Relief to Hire
description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than  3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

Roo Veterinary is building the modern labor marketplace and operating system for veterinary care. We help hospitals reliably staff shifts and access great veterinary professionals, so care happens when it's needed, without burning out teams.

We're hiring a General Manager to run Relief-to-Hire, the business that turns relief work on Roo into full-time hires. Hospitals book relief veterinarians and technicians on Roo every day, and some of those shifts turn into job offers. Relief-to-Hire makes that a product: hospitals try before they hire and pay a placement fee only when a hire happens. Reporting directly to the CEO and serving as a member of the management team, you'll own the Relief-to-Hire P&L (placement revenue, contribution margin, and the investment decisions behind them) and be accountable for making Roo the way veterinary practices hire, instead of a job ad or a recruiter.

Relief-to-Hire is an established, growing business: hundreds of hospitals have hired through it, and it has grown every year alongside the relief marketplace it's built on. Until now it has been run by a cross-functional squad rather than a dedicated owner; in January 2027 it becomes its own business unit with a P&L, a budget and a GM. You'll lead a small placement team directly, set priorities for a dedicated product manager and growth analyst, and get much of your leverage from design, engineering, lifecycle marketing and data partners you don't manage. The core of the job: generate hiring intent, use product and automation to turn one-sided interest into mutual interest, and focus people on closing hires.

Key Responsibilities

• Own Relief-to-Hire revenue and contribution margin against plan, and set a plan that beats the business's momentum when the evidence supports it.

• Write the business strategy and the scorecard behind it: the funnel from relief relationships to hand-raises, mutual interest, closed placements and average fee, with one owner per metric.

• Allocate budget and headcount by ROI: invest in product and automation before people, and put people where a human closes the hire.

• Design pricing and terms as one system (placement fee, guarantee, payment plans, enterprise caps and lookbacks) and manage the cash cycle from agreement through invoice and collection.

• Define and own the Relief-to-Hire category with Marketing, so "try before you hire" becomes the default way a practice hires and the term points to Roo.

• Set product priorities for the hiring flow, the recruiter tool and lifecycle campaigns with your product manager and designer; build what only Relief-to-Hire needs and partner with the platform team on shared infrastructure.

• Partner with the Enterprise, Independent Hospitals, Veterinary and Technician GMs on shared supply: agree how placements are credited and what they cost, and make Relief-to-Hire easy for their teams to sell.

• Build and lead the placement team: hire to a high bar, measure and pay on closed hires and cash collected, act on underperformance early, and develop the people who hold hospital relationships.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will:

• Grow placement revenue above plan, with contribution margin inside the guardrail agreed with Finance.

• Grow Relief-to-Hire faster than the relief marke

title: Head of Risk
description:
About the Role:
One owner for the entire risk function at a fintech operating between crypto and traditional payments. You will own enterprise risk end to end, including the risk framework and appetite, DORA and operational resilience, B2B partner risk, fraud risk appetite, capital adequacy, and risk gating for new products.
It is an individual contributor role reporting directly to the CEO, with a seat on the leadership team. You will work daily with Compliance, Legal, Finance, Technology, and the B2B Partnerships team. The foundations are in place (risk register, appetite framework, DORA workstreams). The function needs an owner who proactively surfaces risk, takes a position, and stands behind it.
What You'll Do:
Enterprise Risk & Governance:

• Own the enterprise risk framework: risk register, risk appetite statement, taxonomy, and escalation policy.

• Run the risk reporting cycle: structured updates to the CEO and leadership, plus regulatory risk reporting.

• Chair or co-chair the risk committee: agenda, cadence, participants, and decision authority.

• Build risk ownership across business units.

DORA & Operational Resilience:

• Own the DORA ICT risk framework and lead the Register of Information workstream ahead of the 2027 submission window.

• Own business continuity and disaster recovery planning.

• Own third-party and vendor risk: critical providers, concentration risk, and exit planning.

• Own the PSD2 operational resilience framework, including 4-hour major incident reporting and impact tolerances.

• Partner with the CTO and Head of Security on technology and cloud risk.

EMI & Regulatory Risk:

• Lead the operational risk framework and capital adequacy/safeguarding design for two parallel EMI applications (EU and UK).

• Own ongoing capital adequacy monitoring and escalate breaches.

• Own preparation for risk-focused regulatory examinations and act as the primary contact for risk-related regulator queries.

• Coordinate with Legal on regulatory obligations and with the Chief of Compliance on AML/CTF risk appetite.

B2B Partner & Counterparty Risk:

• Design and own the partner risk assessment framework: onboarding scoring, ongoing due diligence, and risk-tiered monitoring.

• Own risk sign-off on material partnerships, define thresholds for CEO approval, and keep high-risk reviews fast and credible.

• Define which industries, geographies, and business models the company will and will not serve.

• Manage partner concentration risk and delegated-compliance liability as B2B volume scales.

Fraud & Financial Crime Risk:

• Build a unified fraud risk framework and appetite across relevant functions, with clear ownership and a single escalation path.

• Set fraud risk appetite by channel, product, and geography, and own decisions when thresholds are breached.

• Coordinate with the Chief of Compliance on the fraud/AML overlap.

• Own the sanctions screening risk framework and escalation policy.

Product & Financial Risk:

• Own product-launch risk gating for new products, markets, and business lines.

• Manage crypto price volatility exposure: conversion timing, settlement risk, and liquidity buffers.

• Own counterparty credit risk: liquidity providers, banking partners, card schemes, and B2B clients.

• Oversee treasury risk: balances, currency exposure, and concentration.

Requirements:

Must have:

• Senior risk leadership (Head of Risk, VP Risk, or equivalent scope) in financial services or fintech within a regulated institution.

• Direct ownership of risk obligations in a licensed fintech, EMI, PSP, payment institution, or crypto company, not advisory or consultancy experience only.

• Hands-on experience with at least one of: DORA ICT risk framework, MiCA capital adequacy and risk requirements, PSD2 operational resilience, or FCA operational resilience.

title: Data Center Network Operations Engineer
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Hiring Locations: Atlanta, GA, Austin, US, Denver, CO, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Washington DC, US

About the department

In this role, you will be focused on maintaining the Cloudflare global network. You'll work closely with Cloudflare’s SRE (Site Reliability Engineering) team, Network Engineering team, Network Deployment Engineering team and with various vendors and partners (including hardware vendors, datacenter and network providers, and ISPs) to maintain and improve our global infrastructure. You will further be responsible for the development and implementation of consistent processes and visibility measurements for consistent and effective management of our infrastructure. This is a highly visible position that requires deep technical understanding of datacenter infrastructure, networking (physical), and basic experience with data analysis and project management.

To be successful in this position, you should have excellent technical skills, communication skills, and be able to navigate a range of challenges and constraints (e.g. schedule adherence, time zones, and cultures). You will have the opportunity to (literally) build a faster, safer Internet for our millions of users and the billions of web surfers that visit their sites each month.

Who you are

You will thrive in a hypergrowth engineering environment and be self driven with a keen attention to detail. You will come with a deep technical understanding of Data Center colocation environments, network architecture and server technologies. You will be used to working through partners to support infrastructure delivery to a number of remote locations. You will have had experience managing operational environments, and used to developing new approaches to improve delivery efficiency or operational stability.

•
Collaborating with internal teams (Infrastructure, Network Engineering and SRE). Create documentation and manage remote contractors to complete datacenter tasks, working with hardware manufacturers, datacenter and network providers, logistics partners and other service providers in support of our 330+ cities and 125+ countries

•

title: Data Science Tech Lead Manager, Model Experience
locationText: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role
As part of our growing Data Science and Analytics team, you will play an instrumental role in our company's mission of building safe and beneficial artificial intelligence by driving data-informed decision making across our organization. You bring experience from high-bar teams and are eager to help shape the norms and best practices of a growing data science team as Anthropic continues to scale. In this unique company, technology, and moment in history, your work will be critical to informing our strategy as we deploy safe, frontier AI at scale to the world.

You'll be the senior data science leader for Model Experience and a strategic thought partner to product, engineering, and research leaders. Working where frontier AI research reaches the public, you'll help shape model roadmap and launch decisions, bringing a point of view on how users experience our models and what good looks like beyond benchmark scores. As a tech lead manager, you'll also hire and manage a team of data scientists, setting their agenda, personally leading the highest-stakes analyses, and raising the bar for how data shapes model and product decisions.

Responsibilities:

• Act as a strategic thought partner to product, engineering, and research leaders, helping shape model roadmap priorities, launch decisions, and the major bets the team makes

• Set the data science agenda for Model Experience, deciding where the team can have the most impact on model development and launch decisions and what it should deprioritize

• Hire, manage, and develop a team of data scientists, coaching them to move from answering questions to shaping decisions

• Frame the most important and ambiguous questions about model quality and user experience, size the opportunities, and make clear recommendations, including when they challenge the current direction

• Define how Model Experience measures success, establishing the core metrics and measurement frameworks across external products and internal testing that align teams and leadership on what matters

• Set the standard for experimentation and causal inference across Model Experience, including where launches lack a clean A/B test, and personally lead the highest-stakes analyses

• Turn complex analyses of model and user behavior into clear narratives and recommendations that drive decisions with senior leadership and cross-functional partners

• Establish foundational data practices and shape the analytics infrastructure Model Experience needs to support rapid iteration and decision-making as our models and products evolve

You may be a good fit if you:

• Have extensive experience in data science, including leading analytics for a product or research area at significant scale

• Have 3+ years managing data science teams, including setting team direction, hiring, and developing senior data scientists

• Have been a trusted partner to senior product, research, and business leaders, with clear examples of changing a roadmap or high-stakes decision

• Bring strong product sense and business judgment, including the ability to frame the right question and take a position with incomplete information

• Have deep expertise in experimental design, causal inference, and statistical modeling at high scale, with enough fluency in Python and SQL to stay hands-on and guide others' technical work

• Communicate clearly in writing and in presentations, including to executive audiences

• Have a bias for action and thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you must create clarity and drive progress

• Care about the company's mission of building helpful, honest, and harmless AI

title: Paid Search Strategist, DTC eCommerce
description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
That is the whole job.
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
Requirements
What the job looks like

•
Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.

•
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.

•
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.

•
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.

•
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.

•
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.

•
Own the

K-12 education is one of the most consequential determinants of a child’s future - and many families have had limited ability to shape how and where their child learns. Education Savings Account (ESA) programs along with the Education Freedom Tax Credit are changing that. One of the fastest-growing public education initiatives in the U.S., they give states the ability to put education funding directly in the hands of families, who can then choose the learning experiences that best fit their child - from schools and tutors to therapy, curriculum, and technology.

But once these policies are signed into law, states face an enormous operational challenge. They must stand up entirely new programs, manage the secure and compliant flow of public funds, approve and monitor thousands of vendors, support families at scale, and prevent fraud - all while delivering a high-quality user experience.

That’s where Odyssey comes in.

We partner with state agencies to design, launch, and operate ESA and school choice programs on their behalf. Today, we operate across 10 states, and our platform powers programs serving 250,000+ students and over $2B in annual education funding - and we’re just getting started.

Most recently, we launched the Texas Education Savings Account (EFA) program - the biggest day-one ESA launch in the country - which has already received nearly 200,000 applications. It’s the kind of moment that captures exactly what we’re building toward: programs that work at scale, from day one, when it matters most.

title: Safety Assurance Analyst
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

SAFETY ASSURANCE ANALYST

🛡️ About our Safety Team

Wayve is looking for Safety Assurance Analysts to support the ongoing monitoring and assurance of safety performance across our operations. You'll play an important role in ensuring that operational safety controls are functioning effectively, identifying emerging risks, and providing clear, evidence-based insights that support safe and reliable operations.

Working with operational safety data, you'll review Vehicle Safety Operator (VSO) driving data, incidents, interventions, model flags, Driver Monitoring System (DMS) events, operational process evidence, and other safety-relevant information to identify trends, control failures, behavioral concerns, and emerging operational risks. You will collaborate across cross-functional teams and international time zones to deliver impactful safety metrics and operational insights, providing concrete evidence of Wayve's commitment to safe operations.

This is a hands-on, analytical role requiring strong attention to detail, impartial judgement, and the ability to translate complex operational information into actionable safety insights.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You'll execute day-to-day operational safety assurance activities, using dashboards, reporting tools, and safety performance monitoring systems to assess operational performance and validate the effectiveness of safety controls.

You'll become a power user of Wayve's operational dashboards, analyzing driving data, incidents, interventions, driver monitoring outputs, model flags, and field observations to identify trends, anomalies, and leading indicators of risk.

You'll also support safety investigations by collecting and reviewing evidence, reconstructing event timelines, identifying contributing factors, and documenting findings. Through recurring safety performance reports and investigation summaries, you'll help ensure that emerging risks and potential control failures are clearly understood and communicated.

🧩 What you'll be working on:

- Monitoring operational safety performance: Review VSO driving data, incidents, interventions, model flags, DMS events, field observations, and other safety-relevant information to identify trends, anomalies, behavioral concerns, and emerging risks.

- Validating operational safety controls: Execute assurance activities to assess whether operational controls and safety processes are functioning effectively, identifying potential control failures and areas requiring further investigation.

- Analysing safety data and dashboards: Use Wayve's operational dashboards and reporting tools to interrogate safety metrics, identify patterns, and generate meaningful insights into operational safety performance.

- Identifying leading indicators of risk: Analyze operational datasets, driver monitoring outputs, model flags, incidents, and field observations to identify early warning signs of potential safety concerns.

- Supporting safety investigations: Collect and review evidence, reconstruct incident timelines, apply root-cause thinking, analyze contributing factors, and clearly document investigation findings.

- Producing recurring safety reports: Prepare weekly safety performance packs, monthly assurance reports, investigation summaries, and incident write-ups that communicate findings clearly and support informed decision-making.

- Maintaining data and evidence quality: Validate the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of operational data while recognizing limitations in the underlying evidence.

- Communicating actionable safety insights: Translate complex operational data and investigation findings into concise, object

title: Implementation Specialist
description:
Implementation Specialist
Location: Kansas City metro preferred; remote within the U.S. considered
About Daupler

Serving millions of citizens across the U.S., Daupler helps the professionals who run essential services deliver faster, more reliable operations, whether responding to a burst water main, flagging contaminated drinking water, or keeping customers informed during a power restoration. We are the infrastructure for customer service excellence: a utility within a utility. Backed by leading investors and growing quickly, we’re looking for mission-driven people to help bring American infrastructure, and government, into the 21st century.
About the Role
The Implementation Specialist is where the customer relationship comes to life after the deal is signed. You’ll guide new customers from signed contract to full production - configuring our platform to fit their operations, coordinating across teams, and making sure every customer’s first experience with Daupler is a great one. This is a customer-facing, consultative role: you’ll listen closely to understand each customer’s needs, communicate the value of what we do in terms that matter to them, and represent Daupler throughout onboarding. Strong implementations build trust, deepen adoption, and open the door to growth, and you’ll be central to all three.
This is fundamentally a people role. We can teach the technology; we’re looking for someone who connects with customers and keeps complex work organized and on track.
What You’ll Do

• Partner with our Customer Support, Account Management, and Sales teams to take customers from signed contract to production

• Work directly with customers to configure our software to meet their specific needs

• Serve as a trusted advisor and the face of Daupler during onboarding, building strong relationships and communicating our value clearly and consultatively

• Listen first to understand each customer’s operations, then translate how Daupler solves their challenges

• Partner with Engineering to facilitate and troubleshoot configuration

• Work with internal stakeholders to report on scope, and advise on new features that better support customers

• Surface opportunities to deepen adoption and flag potential expansion internally

• Maintain disciplined, well-organized records of implementation progress, timelines, and customer interactions

What We’re Looking For
The strongest candidates bring:

• A people-first approach: exceptional interpersonal skills, empathy, and the ability to build trust with customers and colleagues.

• Strong organization: you manage multiple implementations, timelines, and details at once without letting things slip. You have a familiarity with project and task management tools: (e.g., Jira, Confluence).

• A consultative, commercial mindset: comfort understanding customer needs and communicating value, with an eye for opportunities to help customers get more from the platform.

• Project management experience: solid planning, execution, and delivery.

title: Research Scientist, Flight Trials
description:
Remote, United States | Full time | Reports to Director, Trials
Applications close November 20, 2026

Who We Are

Contrails.org is a pioneering non-profit working to establish proven contrail avoidance at scale. We are a small, focused team of scientists, engineers, and aviation experts building the science, tools, and operational playbooks to make contrail management a practical reality. Our open-source modelling framework underpins research worldwide, and our real-world trials with major airlines demonstrate that contrail avoidance delivers verifiable climate benefit at a minimal cost.

Our mission is to meaningfully reduce contrail-induced warming by 2030, while establishing the foundations for contrail avoidance to become standard practice in global aviation. We envision a world where intelligent route planning and air traffic management eliminates climate warming contrails with near-zero cost.

Contrails currently cause the same warming impact as 33 billion tonnes of atmospheric CO₂-roughly one year of global anthropogenic emissions. A small subset of flights generates the bulk of this contrail warming, much of which can be avoided through minor altitude or routing adjustments at negligible cost.

What You’ll Do

Contrails.org is seeking a highly motivated and exceptional trial-focused Research Scientist to join our team. You will plan, execute, analyze, and report on real-world flight trials of contrail avoidance, working closely with partner airlines and air navigation service providers (ANSPs) to demonstrate contrail management at scale. You will design scientifically defensible trials, monitor them as they run, turn trial data into actionable results, and communicate those results to research partners and the broader aviation and scientific community. This role sits within the Contrail Clearing Accelerator (CCA), which will run trials across 4 to 8 airlines and 1 to 2 ANSPs. As part of the CCA, you will help design a standardized trial methodology that can be applied across disparate airlines and ANSPs.

Specific Responsibilities

Development and analysis of flight trials

• Collaborate with our team, partner airlines, and ANSPs to develop trial options and to design, develop, and implement real-world trials of contrail avoidance.

• Use Contrails.org and partner tools to plan high-impact, scientifically defensible trials, including pre-test modeling of contrail impacts and effects of trial design decisions.

• Monitor the progress of trials in execution, including accessing raw data sources, converting data into insights, and clearly communicating trial progress to stakeholders.

• Conduct post-trial analysis, determining avoidance effectiveness and costs using modeled and observed results, and uncovering relevant human and operational factors.

• Cross-check flight planning outputs, filed flight plans, flown telemetry, and satellite observations to verify what avoidance was attempted and achieved.

• Work with partners to provide data and support in using our tools to facilitate the success of trials.

Operational protocol development

• Document trial learnings and operational findings in a form that supports the development of repeatable, safety-sound operational protocols and playbooks.

• Support the translation of trial results into procedures and guidance usable by airline and ANSP partners.

Innovation and problem solving

• Identify innovative solutions to complex technical and operational challenges in trial design and execution, enhancing scientific understanding and technological capabilities and performance.

• Continuously improve analysis and tools in response to partner feedback.

Collaboration and communication

• Work closely with team members to align trial work with strategic objectives.

• Build and help maintain relationships with partner airlines and ANSPs, including preparing briefing materials and representing Contrails.org in partner meetings and before external audiences.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description: Je bent vol energie om aan je carrière te beginnen. Het pad van data engineer klinkt als muziek in je oren, maar hoe je in die rol gaat groeien en waar je dat precies wilt doen, dat is nog een vraagteken. No worries, de opdracht Data Engineer is het antwoord! Samen gaan we ontdekken welke weg het beste bij jou past. Wat kan je verwachten? Met deze opdracht geven we jouw carrière als data engineer een flitsende start! In slechts twee jaar tijd haal jij niet alleen toffe certificaten binnen, maar krijg je ook volop trainingen op ons gezellige kantoor in Bunnik. En dat is nog niet alles - je groeit als een speer door aan de slag te gaan bij (één van) onze opdrachtgevers. Het traject is opgedeeld in twee fasen. Het eerste jaar geven we niet alleen je persoonlijke ontwikkeling een boost, maar dompelen we je ook onder in de verschillende facetten van een data engineer. Hoe we dit doen? In de eerste twee weken ben je te vinden op ons Bunnikse kantoor, waar je niet alleen je nieuwe collega’s ontmoet, maar ook toffe trainingen volgt om je hard en soft skills bij te schaven. Het tweede jaar is aan jou om in te vullen, uiteraard word je daarin begeleid door ons: we stellen samen jouw unieke ontwikkelplan op! title: Product Manager, Developer Ecosystem
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

About the Team
Reddit 's developer ecosystem is one of the biggest opportunities to make Reddit more useful, expressive, extensible, and valuable. Today, most people who build on Reddit are developers: they write code, use Devvit, work with APIs, and ship apps or games through a relatively technical workflow. That ecosystem is growing quickly and remains critical.
But the future is bigger than developers alone. AI-assisted building is changing who can create software. The next generation of Reddit apps, games, tools, community agents, content formats, and workflows should be buildable by many more people: developers, technically curious creators, moderators, community builders, game designers, data partners, and eventually people who can describe what they want without needing to code it by hand.
The Developer Ecosystem team owns the product systems that help this broader set of builders discover opportunities, create successfully, launch high-quality apps and games, reach the right users and communities, adopt new platform capabilities, and keep improving after launch. This includes surfaces and systems like developers.reddit.com, AI-assisted creation, app review, developer and creator onboarding, app marketplace experiences, platform capabilities, best practices, and support for emerging creator categories.
About the Role
We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead Reddit 's Builder Ecosystem product strategy. This person will define the roadmap for how Reddit moves from a developer-only ecosystem to a broader builder ecosystem where AI-assisted and no-code creation become first-class parts of the platform.
The role spans developer growth, creator onboarding, AI-assisted building, app quality, ecosystem incentives, platform capabilities, app marketplace strategy, operational tooling, feature adoption, and new builder categories.
This is a high-ambiguity platform role with direct business, product, and community impact. The right PM will be able to bridge two worlds: they should understand the needs of serious developers and platform engineers, while also having strong conviction that Reddit can unlock a much larger wave of builders by making creation more accessible, guided, AI-native, and outcome-oriented.
What You'll Do

• Define the product strategy for Reddit 's Developer Ecosystem, including the transition from code-first developers to a broader base of AI-assisted creators.

• Own the roadmap for developers.reddit.com as the primary builder portal, including onboarding, docs, app management, analytics, review status, feature access, education, examples, templates, and AI-assisted creation entry points.

• Lead strategy for AI-assisted app creation, including prompt-to-app workflows, AI building tools, no-code or low-code experiences, reusable templates, generated scaffolds, and systems that help creators turn ideas into useful Reddit -native apps.

• Build the product approach for an App Marketplace that helps users, moderators, communities, and internal teams discover high-quality apps, games, agents, tools, and community experiences.

• Improve app review and ecosystem operations through tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows, including LLM-powered app review, policy checks, quality signals, and reviewer efficiency.

• Partner with Engineering to prioritize core platform capabilities and performance improvements such as webhooks, webviews, APIs, SDKs, tooling, observability, and other primitives builders need to create reliable apps.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Frontend)
description:
Footprint is the agentic platform that learns your compliance program and runs it end to end.

Compliance teams at banks and fintechs are drowning in financial crimes investigations. Transaction volumes are surging, regulators keep raising the bar, and the work still runs on manual review queues stitched together from legacy vendors. Percy, our agentic system, learns each team's procedures and makes the same calls their analysts would: clearing false positives, escalating real risk, writing the case narrative, and documenting every decision for audit. It cuts review workloads by 70%+.

The harder problem is underneath. Every investigation is grounded in the data sources compliance teams already trust, and every case commits to an organizational memory that compounds - so a pattern one analyst caught in March surfaces automatically in October, across KYC, EDD, sanctions, and monitoring. Whether the team is five analysts or 500, they share one brain. Every memory carries provenance. Agents propose; humans approve. That's four years of identity infrastructure sitting under the agent, and it's the part nobody can bolt on later.

We're backed by QED, Index, and Box Group, and trusted by FDIC- and OCC-regulated banks plus fintechs like Bilt, Nuvei, and MoonPay. We 5x'd revenue last year. The team is small, senior, and ships fast.

THE ROLE

For four years, Footprint's frontend was the front door for developers: onboarding flows customers embed, SDKs they integrate, a dashboard where they configure verification.

Percy changed who lives in the product. Over the past year, compliance teams and investigators moved from configuring Footprint to working inside it: reviewing what an agent found, editing the case narrative, signing off on decisions a regulator will read. The interface became the place our users do their job, and the bar for polish, speed, and clarity rose with it.

The team that owns all of this is a small team of senior engineers. The design system, the SDKs, the monorepo tooling, the release pipeline - all of it runs through them, and they set the standards the rest of engineering ships frontend against.

You'll report directly to Head of Frontend Engineering - Rafael Motta.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- User-facing features, end to end. From spec to build to deploy to iterate, making the product and design tradeoffs along the way. The analyst-facing surfaces are the newest part of the product and the least settled

- The SDKs external developers use to embed Footprint. Clean APIs and good docs here shape our customers' integration experience directly, and those decisions are hard to take back once someone has shipped against them

- Platform and tooling. CI/CD, releases, and our pnpm monorepo. This work has been carried alongside product work, which is why it's on this list

- Performance and observability. You own the performance budgets and the monitoring for screens people sit in all day

- The design system. Own and evolve the component library, keeping the UI consistent, accessible, and fast to build on

- Customer empathy. Talk to the people who use what you build and turn what they struggle with into the product

STACK

React · TypeScript · Next.js · Tailwind · Vercel

Deep experience with most of this, and the judgment to pick up the rest, is what matters.

MUST-HAVE

- 4+ years shipping production frontend in modern React and TypeScript - fluent in both, and comfortable moving fast in a large shared codebase

- You ship end to end, prioritize outcomes, and make smart tradeoffs between speed, polish, and scope

- Genuine design sense - you sweat the details, and the interfaces you ship show it

- You write readable, well-structured code and can lead technical decisions without over-engineering

- You've owned the lifecycle of what you ship: the release, the performance budget, and the alert that fires when it regresses

- You use AI to move faster and raise quality, and you read every line you ship

NICE-TO-HAVE

- Experi

title: Research Administrator 3 (Pre-Award)
description:
The Stanford Department of Neurology has been a center of excellence for more than four decades and supports one of the top research programs in the U.S. with over 200 faculty serving as leaders in the neurological sciences.
The Department of Neurology is seeking a highly motivated Research Administrator 3 (RA3) to support our faculty Principal Investigators (PIs) as they seek external research funding. This position is focused on pre-award administration, and this person will play a critical role in advancing the departments’ research enterprise. This person will serve as a resource expert and manage the preparation of complex research proposals, including grants, contracts, program projects, and cooperative agreements involving multiple PIs, multiple subaward sites, and varied cross-school initiatives. The role will also provide an opportunity to mentor staff and lead process improvement projects. The RA3 will have a passion for supporting research, thrive on complexity, possess exceptional attention to detail, be adept in multitasking, and bring a resourceful and collaborative approach to the work. This person will also have excellent communication skills in order to advocate for PIs within Stanford’s diverse academic and medical community.
DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Certified Research Administrator (CRA) certification.

• Complex proposal preparation experience in an academic environment.

• Experience managing multiple projects and timelines in a dynamic research setting.

• Extreme attention to detail.

• Working knowledge of sponsored project guidelines and the research regulatory environment.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS*:

• Frequently sit, grasp lightly, use fine manipulation and perform desk-based computer tasks, lift, carry, push and pull objects weighing up to ten pounds.

• Occasionally stand, walk, grasp forcefully, use a telephone, write by hand and sort and file paperwork or parts.

• Rarely lift, carry, push and pull objects weighing 11-20 pounds.

* - Consistent with its obligations under the law, the University will provide reasonable accommodation to any employee with a disability who requires accommodation to perform the essential functions of his or her job.
WORK STANDARDS:

• Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrates the ability to work well with Stanford colleagues and clients and with external organizations.

• Promote Culture of Safety: Demonstrates commitment to personal responsibility and value for safety; communicates safety concerns; uses and promotes safe behaviors based on training and lessons learned.

• Subject to and expected to comply with all applicable University policies and procedures, including but not limited to the personnel policies and other policies found in the University's Administrative Guide, .

ADDITIONAL DUTIES*:

• Coordinate preparation and submission of NIH Research Performance Progress Reports (RPPRs) by working with PIs, ORO, post-award teams, and collaborators; collect financial and progress data; develop checklists and timelines; ensure compliance with sponsor and institutional policies.

• Maintain and update Other Support documentation with PIs and post-award teams; verify completeness and compliance to support timely submission for Just in Time requests, progress reports, and internal reviews.

* - Other duties may also be assigned.

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra is at the forefront of increasing access to evidence-based, efficacious mental health services on a large scale. Scientific publications on Lyra’s mental health coaching (Coaching Effectiveness), (Coaching Outcomes), psychotherapy [(Blended Care effectiveness), (Examining Blended Care impact)], (medication management), and overall workforce mental health programs [(Presenteeism impact), (Impact of psychotherapy)] provide strong evidence for the clinical effectiveness of these evidence-based treatment programs.

description:

Senior Site Reliability Engineer & Duties:
The Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Sr. SRE) ensures the reliability, performance, and scalability of all platform services. This role combines software engineering and operations expertise to build resilient systems, automate manual work, improve observability, and reduce operational risk. The Sr. SRE partners closely with DevOps, Release Engineering, and Security to embed reliability practices into every stage of the software lifecycle.

Pay Range
USD $120,000.00 - USD $125,000.00 /Yr.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities included the following. Other duties may be assigned.

• Define and maintain Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and error budgets for critical services.

• Lead capacity planning, performance tuning, design tuning and availability reviews with product and engineering teams to evaluate and develop system health. Run regular Game Day and disaster recovery exercises to validate platform resilience.

• Eliminate manual “click-ops” by automating infrastructure provisioning, patching, and runtime hygiene using Terraform, Ansible, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Develop tooling to enforce compliance (SOC2, CIS benchmarks) across environments.

• Serve as Tier-2 escalation during incidents to quickly and effectively solve problems and lead technical deep dives and root cause analysis.

• Partner with the Incident Response to improve playbooks, on-call rotations, and postmortems. Reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to recovery (MTTR) through automation and proactive engineering.

• Embed security best practices in system design (IMDSv2, hardened golden images, secret rotation). Work with Security to maintain least-privileged IAM policies, patch compliance, and audit readiness.

• Identify sources of toil and drive automation to eliminate repetitive manual tasks. Contribute to platform “blueprints” and self-service modules so development teams can operate within reliable guardrails.

• Measure system performance and track and publish reliability metrics to leadership; use data to drive iterative improvements, minimize risk, and push system capabilities forward.

• Other duties as assigned by management. Must be able to come to work promptly and regularly. Must be able to take direction and work well with others. Must be able to work under the stress of deadlines. Must be able to concentrate and perform accurately. Must be able to react to change productively.

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years’ experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Systems Engineering roles.
